summary: The bad double-checked-locking path reads and publishes stringBad without a memory barrier, so another thread can observe a non-null reference before the assigned value is fully visible (CWE-609). Making the field volatile adds the required happens-before relationship, which is the standard safe form of double-checked locking and preserves the lazy-initialization feature exactly (same value, same lock behavior).

edits.new: private volatile static String stringBad = null;
